# Fishing Nice Okinawa

> English-first information and inquiry site for Okinawa fishing charters and related fishing experiences.

Canonical URL: https://fishing.nice.okinawa/
Booking email: info@nice.okinawa
Service area: Okinawa, Japan

## Services

- Shared boat fishing experiences for beginners departing from Kadena Fishing Port
- Private fishing charters for your group only
- GT, Tuna, Amberjack, Jigging, Live Bait, Trolling, FAD (Payao), Bottom Fishing and seasonal species
- Overnight expeditions and remote island charter enquiries for Ishigaki Island and Miyako Island
- All-inclusive booking coordination, English and WhatsApp support with trusted local captains
- Related activity coordination, including snorkeling, SUP, kayaking and car rental

## Plans and pricing

- Private Charter half-day (4h): ¥72,000 per private boat, all-inclusive.
- Private Charter full-day (7–8h): ¥108,000 per private boat, all-inclusive.
- Private half-day + snorkeling combination: ¥82,000 per package, all-inclusive.
- Shared Boat half-day: ¥12,000 per person; guests under 12: ¥8,000 per person.
- Shared Boat full-day: ¥18,000 per person.
- Remote island charters to Ishigaki and Miyako by enquiry.

## Ports and capacity

- Chatan American Village Port (West Coast), Uruma Awase Port (East Coast), Kadena Fishing Port (shared boat experience).
- Private charters are your group only. Maximum 12 persons.
- Over 30 years of experience. Communication via translation app; English, Mandarin and Japanese supported.

## What you can catch and when

- Tip Run (Red Monster Squid): Bigfin Reef Squid (Aori) · Red Monster. Season: Dec – mid Jun · Peak: Apr – mid Jun.
- GT Fishing (Giant Trevally): Giant Trevally (GT). Season: Year-round · Peak: Apr–Jul & Oct–Dec.
- Giant Hairtail: Giant Hairtail (Tachiuo). Season: Jul – Nov.
- Deep Sea Jigging: Amberjack (カンパチ) · Coral Grouper (スジアラ) · Rock Fish. Season: Peak: Jan – Jun.
- SLJ (Super Light Jigging): Reef Fish · Pelagics · Various species. Season: Peak: Jul – Oct.
- Gomeoku Tenya: Snapper · Reef Fish · Emperor Fish · Various bottom species. Season: Year-round.

Monthly recommendations:

- Jan: Deep Sea Jigging
- Feb: Deep Sea Jigging
- Mar: Deep Sea Jigging
- Apr: GT Fishing (Giant Trevally), Tip Run (Red Monster Squid)
- May: GT Fishing (Giant Trevally), Tip Run (Red Monster Squid)
- Jun: GT Fishing (Giant Trevally), Tip Run (Red Monster Squid)
- Jul: Giant Hairtail, SLJ (Super Light Jigging)
- Aug: Giant Hairtail, SLJ (Super Light Jigging)
- Sep: Giant Hairtail, SLJ (Super Light Jigging)
- Oct: GT Fishing (Giant Trevally), Giant Hairtail, SLJ (Super Light Jigging)
- Nov: GT Fishing (Giant Trevally), Giant Hairtail
- Dec: GT Fishing (Giant Trevally), Tip Run (Red Monster Squid)

## Cancellation

- Two weeks or more before departure: the all-inclusive package price is refunded minus the coordination fee; the coordination fee is non-refundable.
- Cancelled by the captain for typhoon or sea conditions: full refund including the coordination fee.

## Other facts

- Children can join; tell us their ages when booking. Life jackets provided for everyone.
- Fresh catch can be prepared as sashimi on board, or taken back to your hotel.
- GT fishing requires heavy tackle and long-distance casting experience; other plans need no prior experience.

## FAQ excerpt

The FAQ section covers private charters and shared boats, prior fishing experience, fishing gear, bad weather, children, seasickness, supported languages and what is included in the all-inclusive price: the boat charter, English coordination and booking support.

## Booking information to provide

Send the preferred date, group size, preferred fishing style, contact method and any details needed for the captain to arrange the trip. A booking is not confirmed until availability and plan details are agreed.

## Fishing seasons page

- [Okinawa fishing seasons month by month](https://fishing.nice.okinawa/fishing-seasons/): English guide organized by January through December, with six methods covered: GT Fishing (Giant Trevally), Deep Sea Jigging, Tip Run (Squid), Giant Hairtail (Tachiuo), SLJ (Super Light Jigging) and Gomeoku Tenya. It also explains that visitors do not have to pick the method themselves — send dates and fishing experience, and the captain recommends what to target.

## Stay area guide

- [Where to stay in Okinawa for fishing charters](https://fishing.nice.okinawa/en/guides/where-to-stay-fishing/): English guide for matching accommodation areas to the real fishing departure ports used on this site. Chatan American Village Port and Chatan Hamagawa Port are west-coast options, Kadena Fishing Port is used for the shared fishing boat experience, and Uruma Awase Port is an east-coast option. The guide explains that Okinawa is large and the wrong stay area can add a one to two hour one-way transfer before an early fishing departure.

## Fishing package guide

- [Okinawa fishing packages](https://fishing.nice.okinawa/en/guides/okinawa-fishing-packages/): English enquiry page comparing a ¥72,000 private half-day charter from Chatan and a ¥82,000 private half-day + snorkeling combination. Both are all-inclusive package prices; booking coordination and WhatsApp support are provided, and the page explains that full details are confirmed after the date and group size are checked.

## Trip reports

- [Chatan full-day amberjack trip report, August 2026](https://fishing.nice.okinawa/en/trip-reports/chatan-full-day-amberjack-aug-2026/): A real four-guest private full-day charter from Chatan, covering the English booking flow, card hold, local weights, electric reels, 25 fish (20 tuna, 4 rainbow runner and 1 amberjack), same-day sashimi on board when the catch allowed, an ATM stop and ¥166,000 paid in total for four people including the charter, gear rental and the day's other costs.

## How booking works

- [What happens after you book](https://fishing.nice.okinawa/en/how-booking-works/): an English seven-step guide covering the enquiry, captain confirmation, one confirmation email, temporary PayPal card hold (not a payment), the evening-before check-in, meeting at the port, and what happens if weather or plans change.
